---
name: refresh-index
description: "Regenerates docs/us/INDEX.md from the frontmatter of every US file. Used by the finalizer, or on demand for an overview of in-flight work."
---

# refresh-index

1. Read the frontmatter of every `docs/us/US-*.md`: `id`, `title`, `status`, `track`, `issue`, `updated`.
2. Overwrite `docs/us/INDEX.md`:

```markdown
# User Stories — Index

> Generated by the `refresh-index` skill. Do not edit by hand. Last refresh: <today>

## Active

| ID | Title | Status | Track | Issue | Updated |
|----|-------|--------|-------|-------|---------|
| [<id>](./<file>) | <title> | `<status>` | <track> | #<issue> | <updated> |

## Done

| ID | Title | Issue | Updated |
|----|-------|-------|---------|
| [<id>](./<file>) | <title> | #<issue> | <updated> |
```

Rules: Active = any status but `done`, sorted by id · empty group → `_(none)_` · missing track/issue → `—` · malformed frontmatter → extra `## ⚠️ Invalid` section (file + reason) · relative links · never modify a US file.
